test_title: PYST 7: SSC GD - GA & GK (Held on: 18th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following is non-justiciable in nature in Indian Constitution?

options.text: Equality of law and equal protection of law
Protection with respect to conviction of offences
Equal justice and free legal aid

solution:
The correct answer is __**Equal justice and free legal aid**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 39A** of the Indian constitution deals with **Equal justice and free legal aid to the poor**.

 
 
• ​It is mentioned in the **Directive Principle Of State Policy** in** Part IV of the Constitution**.
 
• As the Directive Principle Of State Policy is a** non-enforceable and non-justiceable** part of the constitution.
 
• This means that they are **not legally enforceable by the court on their violation**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Article 14** of the Indian Constitution states that **Equality of the law and equal protection of the law** which mean **all** **people are equal in front of the law**.
 
• **Article 20** of the Indian Constitution states the **Protection with respect to conviction of offenses**.
 
• **Article 26** of the Indian constitution provides** Freedom to manage religious affairs**.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
 

 Fundamental Rights 
 
 
Part III, Article (12 to 35), Enforceable and justiceable

 
 
 

 DPSP
 
 
Part IV, Article (36 to 51), Non-enforceable and non-justiceable

 
 
 

 Fundamental Duties
 
 
Part IV-A, Article 51A, Non-enforceable and non-justiceable

 
 
 

7b
